detail.longDescription: Single Go binary (~15 MB RAM), compact SQLite-based storage with configurable retention. Ideal for self-hosted app monitoring. No Prometheus/Grafana stack required. Shows app and DB health, charts for latency, http status codes, native support for Micrometer-based frameworks like Spring Boot/Micronaut/Quarkus. Simple app integration recipes for Django, Express, FastAPI, Go/Gin and others. Live demo: https://pvrlabs.xyz/statlite/demo.html
